passedAreas: Skip links exist on login, register, checkout, legal, support, contact, eligibility, Journey, Lumina, and Architect shell
Language switcher has accessible name, aria-current, lang/hrefLang, and locale-preserving hrefs; html lang follows x-bh-locale
Launch-critical forms generally use visible labels, htmlFor, aria-invalid, and aria-describedby
Age gate uses fieldset/legend and labeled radios
Founder videos use native controls, playsInline, and aria-label; EN+ES VTT files exist for nine launch videos
prefers-reduced-motion is honored globally; no user-scalable=no / maximum-scale lock found
Focus-visible rings exist on CTAs, nav, and form controls
App-shell mobile menu has sr-only open/close text, aria-expanded, aria-controls, and Escape-to-close
Core brand pairs pass WCAG AA: ink on cream 16.93:1, muted body on cream 6.16:1, white on purple CTA 9.06:1, white/65 nav on night 8.46:1

findings.finding: The public homepage has no skip link. Other launch pages use SkipLink; home is the highest-traffic public surface and starts with hero nav.
findings.imaniFix: Add the existing SkipLink to HomePageView targeting a unique main id. Do not change homepage marketing copy.

findings.finding: Account menu toggle has an accessible name, but the menu has no Escape handler, no focus move into the menu, no focus return, and no outside-click/focus trap. Keyboard and screen-reader users can open it and lose a predictable close path.
findings.imaniFix: Add Escape-to-close, move focus to the first menu item on open, restore focus to the trigger on close. Do not change auth/session behavior.

findings.finding: Mobile nav closes on Escape and has aria-hidden when closed, but does not trap focus or move focus into the drawer when opened.
findings.imaniFix: When open, focus the drawer or first link; restore focus to the toggle on close.

findings.finding: Consent checkbox labels are English-only and forced lang="en", including on Spanish register/checkout. File comment forbids auto-translating or inventing Spanish legal acknowledgments. Screen readers will announce English correctly via lang=en; the surrounding Spanish page remains mixed-language until legal Spanish acknowledgments exist.
findings.imaniFix: Do not invent Spanish legal consent copy. Leave until Founder/legal supplies approved Spanish acknowledgments. Then wire locale without dropping lang accuracy.

findings.finding: Purple at 50–55% opacity on cream fails AA: purple/55 on cream 2.81:1; purple/50 on cream 2.52:1 (need 4.5:1 normal / 3:1 large/UI).
findings.imaniFix: Use full bh-purple or another token that meets 4.5:1 on cream. Do not lighten brand purple further. Nia will accept the contrast-safe token, not a new palette.

findings.finding: Placeholder text composites to about 3.18:1 on cream (below 4.5:1).
findings.imaniFix: Use full bh-muted or ink at a passing opacity for placeholders.

findings.finding: Computed white/65 on solid night passes (8.46:1). Real hero is a photo plus veil, so local contrast can dip. Not a token failure; needs a visual pass on the live hero.
findings.imaniFix: After homepage skip-link/contrast token fixes, sample hero nav against the actual image at the default crop. Do not retint the hero photograph without Nia.

findings.finding: Eighteen EN/ES VTT files exist and are wired. Cue timing is duration-weighted by script length, not human-timed to speech. That is not production-accurate captioning.
findings.imaniFix: Keep approved script text. Replace duration-weighted timings with speech-aligned cues (Row 138). Nia accepts timing quality; do not rewrite Founder manuscript copy.

findings.finding: All launch Founder placements have transcriptSrc: null and poster: null. Caption tracks are injected with mode "hidden" and without default, so captions are not shown unless the user finds native CC. Row 138 still open: captions+transcripts+posters required before media is accessibility-complete.
findings.imaniFix: 1) Set the approved caption track to showing or default. 2) Publish transcripts from the already-approved scripts (do not invent copy) and link them in the existing transcript slot. 3) Add accessible posters/fallbacks. Coordinate with Row 138; do not mark videos complete while transcripts/posters are missing.

findings.finding: Skip link uses :focus (correct) and a purple/white chip; CTA/nav/inputs have focus-visible rings. Several outline-none rules are paired with a ring. Account/mobile menus still lack focus movement (A11Y-SR-01/02).
findings.imaniFix: Covered by A11Y-SR-01/02. Do not remove existing focus-visible rings.

findings.finding: No zoom lock (good; Next default viewport). Desktop hero supporting sentence is forced nowrap and can overflow/clip at 200% zoom or narrow desktop widths.
findings.imaniFix: Allow the hero subtext to wrap at 200% zoom / constrained widths. Do not change the sentence copy.

findings.surface: Hero/public nav and language switcher; app-shell toggle is size-10 (40px)
findings.finding: Public header wraps links instead of a disclosure; language-switcher chips are text-[0.62rem] py-1.5 (short of 24px WCAG 2.2 AA in height). App-shell toggle is 40px (near 44px AAA, above 24px AA). Journey stage nav is horizontal-scroll on small screens.
findings.imaniFix: Increase public language-switcher and hero nav hit areas to at least 24×24 CSS px without changing labels. Keep Architect mobile drawer.

findings.surface: components/i18n/language-switcher.tsx; app/layout.tsx; middleware.ts; founder media locale bundles
findings.finding: Switcher preserves path, sets cookie, exposes English/Español with aria-current. html lang follows /es vs default. Founder media resolves EN/ES sources without silent English substitution. Spanish homepage keeps brand-lock English eyebrow/headline ('The Back Half', 'Magical is Possible.') while subtext/CTA translate — treat as brand lock, not an Imani copy change. Consent English-on-Spanish is A11Y-LBL-01.
findings.imaniFix: None for brand-lock headline. After caption/transcript wiring, verify Spanish routes load Spanish VTT/video (already sourced in media locale files).

keyboard.detail: Skip links and native controls exist on most launch pages; homepage skip link missing; account and mobile menus lack full keyboard close/focus behavior.

screenReaderBasics.detail: Landmarks, html lang, labeled forms, live regions on Lumina/loading exist. Homepage skip, menu focus management, and media transcripts remain open.

labels.detail: Visible labels on login/register/support/Lumina/age-gate/Journey exercises. Consent remains English-by-legal-rule.

contrast.detail: Core body/CTA/nav-on-night pass. Index numerals at purple/50–55 on cream and muted/70 placeholders fail AA.

captions.detail: VTT files present for 9 EN + 9 ES Founder videos; timing is duration-weighted; tracks default hidden; transcripts and posters missing.

focus.detail: Visible focus styling is present on primary controls; menu focus movement is not.

zoom.detail: Zoom is not disabled. Hero nowrap at large breakpoints risks overflow at 200%.

mobile.detail: Architect shell has a mobile drawer. Public language switcher/hero nav hit areas are undersized. Reduced-motion exists.

languageSwitching.detail: Route+cookie switcher and html lang are sound. Spanish media sources exist. Legal consent and brand-lock English remain mixed-language by rule.
